Installation & other devices +

Open the APK on Android. If you choose, allow installation from your browser. This is a test build signed with a development key, not a Google Play release.

Read the in-app disclosure, enable RepLock Accessibility in system settings, return to RepLock, and turn on App protection. Some Android versions require allowing restricted settings for sideloaded accessibility services.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
make a move.

How does the camera know I did the reps?+

RepLock estimates body landmarks with on-device ML Kit pose detection. It counts a full movement cycle after several stable frames. Standing still or holding one pose won’t complete a set. Lighting, camera angle, clothing, and mobility can affect detection. This isn’t identity verification or a fitness assessment.

What exactly does app protection do?+

With your permission, Android Accessibility detects the foreground app and covers selected apps with a RepLock shield. It doesn’t read messages, posts, or passwords. Redeeming coins temporarily opens one app. The timer keeps running even if you leave it; the shield returns when the pass expires. This is a voluntary boundary, and can be disabled.

Do I need the camera to earn coins?+

No. Opt into step tracking instead. A device step-counter sensor tracks from activation with a visible notification. Every full 500 steps earns 5 coins, up to 100 coins per day. Claim them in the app. Re-enable tracking after a reboot or service interruption.

What if I need access right away?+

You can pause App protection in Setup whenever you need. Calls, the home screen, Settings, and RepLock are excluded from the app picker. Leave other essential apps unselected. There’s no payment or penalty to pause protection.

Where does my data go?+

Your coin wallet, selected apps, step totals, and recent history stay on this phone. No account or cloud sync. Camera footage isn’t saved. Reset local progress or uninstall to remove the app’s data. Read the privacy notice ↗
